customManagers.description: Update the container images that Octopus deployment process and runbook steps run in, when they come from the 'docker-packages-octopushq-com' feed (an Artifactory mirror). Image names in OCL are relative to the feed, so the match is anchored on the feed line, which Octopus writes immediately before the image line, and the images are looked up against that registry rather than Docker Hub.
